name: IndexTabTeamCard
job: A team card shaped as a file card with side tabs, where choosing a person flips the card to their profile like a Rolodex
visitor_action: click/tap a tab or use arrow keys to flip to a person
mobile: tabs scroll horizontally above the card
motion: card flips down with eased perspective, tab slides forward (reduced-motion: instant swap, tab highlighted)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Registry office: manila card, olive tabs with typed labels, ink stamp accents, light desk shadow
notes: 2026-11-23: targeted fix (Sonnet 5.5, QA fail): reserved stamp zone under the bio (no overlap), tabs get 18-30px inner padding and never truncate names (narrow tabs size to label, wide tabs scale label then wrap), narrow tab row scrolls by design with edge fades so the active tab stays fully visible. QA re-sweep pending. Earlier: card height follows the tallest profile so the deck never jumps. 2026-11-23: surgical fix 2 (tab+names): paperclip/photo moved inside the card edge at narrow widths so it never covers the tab row; names never break mid-word (wrap at spaces/hyphens only, font shrinks to fit the longest piece).
